Love4Senate.com is Preston Love Jr's official personal/campaign domain name. Visiting PrestonLove.com will direct you to a HugeDomains.com landing page where a domain seller is trying to sell it for $595. The Archive.org archive of PrestonLove.com from April 5th, 2023, also directs to HugeDomains. Preston Love Jr.'s 2024 Senate Campaign Facebook page (facebook.com/Love4Senate) lists Love4Senate.com as its official website. PrestonLove.com might have been Love's 2020 Senate campaign site in 2020.
